entities.summary: Lwówek Śląski is a town in the Lower Silesian Voivodeship in south-western Poland. Situated on the Bóbr River, Lwówek Śląski is about 30 kilometres NNW of Jelenia Góra and has a population of about 9,000 inhabitants. It is the administrative seat of Lwówek County and of the municipality Gmina Lwówek Śląski.
